explanation: Leo Tolstoy published it in instalments from 1875 to 1877. Scientists later named the 'Anna Karenina principle' after the opening: success needs many things to go right, failure only one.

claims.text: Anna Karenina opens with the observation that happy families are all alike and every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
War and Peace, Doctor Zhivago and The Brothers Karamazov open with different sentences.
Tolstoy published Anna Karenina in instalments between 1875 and 1877.
The Anna Karenina principle, the idea that success needs many factors to go right while one failure is enough to fail, is named after the novel's opening.
